about: Every attack comes from a direction. Every guard faces one. Meet a slash with the right guard just before it lands and you redirect it: its momentum turns against the attacker.

Seven opponents, each built from the same move cards and the same rules. The readers track what you lean on and tell you; the Oracle plays a duel tree the model solved six exchanges deep; the Architect fights in three phases.
Every number in the game is a card. The equilibria the AIs play are computed exactly by the card model, and the whole game is card-language logic compiled to native code.

notes: The duel: every move card, the combat kernel, guards, evades, redirects, posture and stamina.
Arcade ladder of six opponents, training, options, saves.
The native shell: window, keyboard, gamepads, sound.
changelog.title: First playable

notes: A red arc shows where each cut comes from, and flashes white in the frames where a guard makes a redirect; your guard is a blue arc.
Each fighter has their own look: the Warden's crest, the Duelist's hat, cape and long blade, the Brute's horns and bulk.
The first opponent is gentler, and every opponent moves in and out instead of standing still.
How to duel: on the ladder, and along the bottom of the screen in your first fight.
Redirects and knockouts flash the screen; heavy hits knock you back; louder sound.
changelog.title: Readable vectors

notes: Every arcade stage has its own arena and weather: the dusk bridge, a night temple, a snow pass, an ember forge, storm cliffs and the Architect's hall.
Each opponent introduces itself, and the readers tell you after the duel what they learned about you.
The Architect adapts when it is losing: past half its health it reads sharper.
Training: pick what the dummy does from the pause menu, and read your last move's frame data and outcome.
changelog.title: Six arenas and The Architect

notes: Strings: when a cut connects, hit or blocked, attack again from a new side to cancel its recovery into the next link. Each link is a chain card; every string ends within three hits and every link can still be guarded (design laws GL9 and GL10).

The Oracle, a new stage in its own arena: it plays the duel tree, solved by backward induction six exchanges deep for every distance, frame advantage and posture, and the strings the model says are worth it.
The Architect now fights in three phases written on the game card: it reads you, then plays the tree, then turns every cut into a string, each with its own sky, music and colour.
Redirect a link to break the string. Three new achievements. Training: a dummy that attacks in strings, and the cancel window of your last move in the frame data.
changelog.title: Strings, the Oracle and the Architect's phases

name: vector_duel
short_description: Read the vector, not the button. A sword duel decided by directions, timing, strings and reads, against AIs the card model computed.
statement: A one-on-one sword duel where every attack is a vector and every answer is a vector too: read the direction, guard it, redirect it. The rules are the Vector Counter System's cards (moves, fighters, the combat kernel); the game itself is card-language logic compiled to native code.

strings.S_BRUTE_D: HEAVY. BIG SWINGS, ARMOUR AND GRABS.
strings.S_C3: EVERY MOVE, FIGHTER AND RULE IS A CARD
strings.S_C4: EQUILIBRIA COMPUTED EXACTLY BY THE MODEL
strings.S_C5: COMPILED TO NATIVE CODE THROUGH THE C CARD
strings.S_DUELIST_D: FAST. THRUSTS, FEINTS AND A QUICK FOOT.
strings.S_HOW1: A RED ARC SHOWS WHERE THE CUT COMES FROM
strings.S_HOW2: HOLD L AND PRESS THAT DIRECTION TO GUARD IT
strings.S_HOW3: GUARD AS THE ARC FLASHES WHITE: REDIRECT!
strings.S_HOW4: J + DIRECTION ATTACKS. K HEAVY, U FEINT, SPACE EVADES
strings.S_HOW5: AS A CUT CONNECTS, ATTACK AGAIN FROM A NEW SIDE: A STRING
strings.S_IN_1: THE BRUTE SWINGS FROM ABOVE. GUARD HIGH, CUT FROM THE SIDE.
strings.S_IN_2: THE OPPORTUNIST PUNISHES EVERY MISS. WAIT, THEN ANSWER.
strings.S_IN_3: THE READER COUNTS WHAT YOU DO. VARY IT.
strings.S_IN_4: A READER WITH A HEAVY HAND. ITS OVERHEAD HAS ARMOUR.
strings.S_IN_5: THE BALANCE PLAYS THE EQUILIBRIUM: THERE IS NOTHING TO READ.
strings.S_IN_6: THE ORACLE SOLVED THE DUEL {TREE_DEPTH} EXCHANGES DEEP. SURPRISE IT.
strings.S_IN_7: THE ARCHITECT WROTE THE CARDS. IT FIGHTS IN THREE PHASES.
strings.S_K_ATK: J: ATTACK  K: HEAVY  U: FEINT
strings.S_K_DEF: L: GUARD (HOLD)  SPACE: EVADE  I: CATCH
strings.S_K_DIR: W A S D / ARROWS: VECTOR AND WALK
strings.S_K_STR: STRINGS: J + A NEW DIRECTION AS YOUR CUT CONNECTS
strings.S_K_TIP: GUARD THE SIDE THE RED VECTOR SHOWS. JUST BEFORE IT LANDS: REDIRECT.
strings.S_TAGLINE: READ THE VECTOR, NOT THE BUTTON
